controls.name: (C1) KNOWN dependent data (shared latent e1, e2 for receiver and sources; clock e3): CORR (latent subdivision) contains all 42 truths and is not wider than BOX for r, l, l'; matched widths and cost
(C2) independent versus shared: with SEPARATE latent parameters for receiver and sources (truth at the 16 corners), the evaluator with separate parameters contains every truth
(N1) negative, lost-correlation in its dangerous form: tying the separate receiver and source parameters to ONE shared parameter misses some truth of the independent model
(N2) negative: CORR intersected with a shifted box NOT proved to contain the truth is empty or misses the truth; CORR intersected with BOX (both proved) keeps every truth
(N3) negative: the source-history sensitivity entered with the swapped sign misses some truth (or the contraction empties)

(N4) negative/known: an independent source-history remainder (+-5e-3; v1 used +-2e-4, too small to be missed) present in the truth: omitted by the evaluator -> misses some truth; kept as an interval remainder -> contains every truth
